title: Violation
description: One finding of one rule: what is wrong, and where it is reported. The anchor is a line or a range inside the surface, or the pull request as a whole where no surface line is to blame, including code the change made dead elsewhere, which the body names by file and line. The body states what is wrong, not how to fix it; the citation of the rule is added by the reviewing context, never written by the probe

examples.body: the pipeline's exit status is discarded, so a failing check passes as success.

rule.description: The rule violated, by its id; the same id as the ledger row carrying this violation

body.description: What is wrong, briefly. Without the rule's name or link: the reviewing context prefixes the citation from the rule id

Side.description: RIGHT for a line of the file at the head commit, LEFT for a line removed from the base

Line.description: One line of one file, numbered in the file on the side named, never as a diff hunk offset

Lines.description: Consecutive lines of one file on one side

PullRequest.description: The pull request as a whole: an existing component that replaces a whole module, a standard the change set as a whole does not follow, or code outside the surface that the change made dead, named by file and line in the body. Carried in the review body rather than on a line
